protocol.receiver: What is the opposite of "small"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.donor: What is the opposite of "hot"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.selection: Positive controls require donor gate>0; negative controls require receiver gate>0; pairs require both gates>0 and distinct transform IDs within one layer. Exclude L22 T2339/T941 from controls. Fixed seed, before new intervention outcomes. 50 layer22 and 50 other-layer conditions for each single-edit sign and pair-sign recipe. Repeated strengths are conditions, not independent unique-feature samples.
protocol.source_gate_display: Singles: source-specific gate. Pairs: average of the two source gates, also listing each gate. No averaging across unrelated tokens.
protocol.intervention: Native receiver MLP output at token9 += sum(coefficient * full contribution from clean donor or receiver at token9 of the same layer). No attention freezing.
protocol.source_input: Prenorm residual entering post-attention layernorm; standardization and output scaling from released checkpoint.
protocol.gpu_policy: Reuse and retain SPAR instance55946393. No lifecycle actions.
